definition: Compensation linked to comparison with another role, unit, or jurisdiction.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 6 distinct documented comparability parity implementation events across 6 municipalities in 5 states. Compensation linked to comparison with another role, unit, or jurisdiction. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
